name: Finance Calculator
description: Common business math: percent change, simple interest, and compound interest.

tools.name: finance_calc
tools.description: Runs a financial calculation. operation "percent_change" needs from/to. "simple_interest" and "compound_interest" need principal, rate (as a percent, e.g. 5 for 5%), and years; compound_interest also takes optional compoundsPerYear (default 12).
